sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate denotes the required spatial extent, result, or relationship concept; spacing and thickness are quantity properties only and cannot encode the specified forefoot and upper-bow extents.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the conditional equivalence logic. For IA Super, require forefootShellStrengtheningStatus to equal bowRegionEquivalent, not require both booleans to be true; otherwise the valid case where both are false is rejected. Likewise, for IA/IA Super with openWaterServiceSpeed >= 18, require upperBowIceBeltStrengtheningStatus to equal midbodyEquivalent rather than requiring both true.
